# Alok Das

> Chemistry Graduate & Scientific Software Builder based in Assam, India. M.Sc. Chemistry student at Rabindranath Tagore University, analytical laboratory practitioner, and creator of Alomole, Mileage Tracker, and interactive science simulations.

- [LinkedIn Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alokdasofficial): Professional background, academic connections, and scientific career updates.
- [Google Play Developer Page](https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=Alok+Das): Published Android mobile applications developed by Alok Das.

## Published Software & Web Applications

- [Alomole Chemistry Companion](https://alomolecule.web.app): Domain-specific web application for chemical equation balancing, molar mass calculation, and reaction stoichiometry.
- [Mileage Tracker App Case Study](https://alokdasofficial.in/projects/mileage-tracker-app): Production Android utility on Google Play built with Flutter and SQLite for offline fuel logging and efficiency tracking.
- [Mileage Tracker Web Showcase](https://mileage.alokdasofficial.in): Live web showcase and feature breakdown of the Mileage Tracker mobile utility.
- [Digital Notes & Journal](https://notes.alokdasofficial.in): Clean, minimalist web notes and journaling utility.
- [URL Shortener Service](https://shorturl.alokdasofficial.in): Lightweight link shortening and redirection service.
- [Tickly Productivity Tool](https://tickly.alokdasofficial.in): Fast, minimalist task and habit tracking web application.

## Interactive Science Simulators

- [Acid-Base Titration Simulator](https://alokdasofficial.in/tools/labs/titration): Interactive virtual laboratory computing real-time pH titration curves, indicator transitions, and equivalence points.
- [Beer-Lambert Law Simulator](https://alokdasofficial.in/tools/labs/beer-lambert): Optical spectrophotometry simulator exploring absorbance vs. path length and concentration.
- [Reaction Kinetics Simulator](https://alokdasofficial.in/tools/labs/reaction-kinetics): Kinetic rate laws, Arrhenius activation energy, and concentration vs. time modeling.
- [pH Scale & Ionic Product Visualizer](https://alokdasofficial.in/tools/labs/ph-scale): Dynamic logarithmic pH scale, autoionization of water, and hydronium concentration tool.
- [Refraction & Snell's Law Optics Tool](https://alokdasofficial.in/tools/labs/refraction): Interactive wave optics and refractive index simulator.
- [Ohm's Law & Circuit Simulator](https://alokdasofficial.in/tools/labs/ohms-law): Interactive electrical circuit simulation exploring voltage, current, and resistance relationships.
- [Significant Figures & Measurement Mastery](https://alokdasofficial.in/tools/labs/measurement-sigfigs): Precision measurement and significant figures calculation tool for scientific laboratory data.

## Research Articles & Articles

- [Phytochemical Screening Methods](https://alokdasofficial.in/blog/phytochemical-screening-methods): Systematic guide to qualitative extraction and secondary metabolite screening in laboratory plants.
- [Balancing Chemical Equations Algorithm](https://alokdasofficial.in/blog/balancing-chemical-equations-algorithm): Mathematical modeling and null-space matrix solvers in Dart for balancing complex chemical equations.
- [Offline-First Flutter Architecture](https://alokdasofficial.in/blog/offline-first-flutter-architecture): Technical review of local SQLite persistence and telemetry-free mobile utility design.
